# True Attendly Broadcast — LLM Context Matrix
The Editorial WhatsApp Marketing Platform for High-Retention Retail.

## Platform Essence
A production-grade B2B SaaS architecture running on Next.js 14/15 and Supabase. It eliminates subscription overhead, utilizing a transactional "Pay-As-You-Send" (1 credit per successful message) payment engine powered by Cashfree.

## High-Value Core Modules
1. **AI Message Polisher Engine:** Multi-tier failover routing (Gemini, Groq, SambaNova, Cerebras) that optimizes raw merchant input text into luxury marketing copy, strictly enforcing Meta dynamic tokens ({{1}} for Customer Name, {{2}} for Storefront Name).
2. **Unified Data Ingestion Parser:** Streamlined spreadsheet data matrix accepting massive .csv and .xlsx Excel manifests with atomic 10-digit regex masking and serverless duplicate-safe upserts.
3. **Advanced Database Terminal:** High-performance infinite scroll merchant grid supporting tag-based customer segment filters (VIP, Regular, New).
4. **Master Security Core:** Built-in 5-minute idempotency token guards against double-billing and atomic PL/pgSQL database increment hooks (`public.increment`).
